title: fix: reject invalid minutes on the model status endpoint
author: NamanSoni78

gist.summary: The GET /models/status endpoint now rejects `minutes` values outside the integer range 1–10080 with a 400 response and the error `minutes must be an integer between 1 and 10080`, before contacting Tinybird. Valid values are normalized before forwarding; requests without `minutes` are unchanged. Other upstream errors still pass through.
